messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to run the orders_schema migration this Thu 11:00 UTC. Window: 11:00–12:30 UTC. Expect dual-write for up to 30m and a background backfill afterward. Owners: @aj (deploy), @oliver (smoke), @kevin (rollback plan). Ping if that conflicts.

aj: Ack — I can take deploy. Can we do a hard stop at 12:30 and move the backfill to off-peak if it runs long?

maria: Yep hard stop at 12:30 for app-facing changes. Backfill will continue async on replica-only workers; we'll throttle to keep p95 latency under 250ms.

kevin: Quick question on rollback: if we see write errors during dual-write, what's the immediate action? Mirror revert of feature flag or fail open?

maria: Plan is: 1) flip feature flag to stop writing to new schema (fast path) 2) abort migration job and re-route traffic to previous read path if needed 3) escalate to oncall if errors persist >5m. I've posted the feature flag name in the runbook.

oliver: I'll own smoke tests. My checklist: DB connections sanity, sample read from both old and new columns, end-to-end order create+read, and consumer queue sanity. I'll run these in prod-canary then full after 15m stable.

sarah: Backfill estimate: ~2 hours if unthrottled, but we'll set concurrency=4 and QPS cap so probably ~6 hours. We'll run it on replica nodes only. I'll add the throttling config to the migration job: `--concurrency=4 --qps=150`.

aj: deploy steps for clarity: 1) migrate schema (DDL, non-blocking), 2) enable dual-write flag, 3) monitor errors for 15m, 4) promote reads to new schema gradually. I'll run the DDL in a dry-run earlier Wed night.

maria: Preflight tasks for tomorrow: - @aj run dry-run DDL in staging and post logs here - @sarah validate backfill query plan and cost - @oliver confirm smoke probes + scripts in repo - @kevin sanity-check rollback steps + who to call for DB restore (if needed)

kevin: For DB restore contact is `dba-oncall` and we have the PITR snapshot plan in the infra runbook. For immediate rollback we won't restore; we'll flip flag and stop jobs. Restore is last resort.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Slot reserved by @aj — Thu 11:00–12:30 UTC. CI gate: staging ok, canary ok.

oliver: Smoke script snippet I'll run (also in repo `infra/smoke/orders_smoke.sh`):
```
# quick smoke
curl -sS -X POST "$CANARY_URL/orders" -d '{"item":"test","qty":1}' | jq .id
curl -sS "$CANARY_URL/orders/{id}" | jq .schema_version
psql -c "select count(*) from orders where created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes';"
```

maria: Good. One more: please post the abort message template we'll use for the incident channel if we need to rollback, e.g., `Rolling back orders_schema migration — stopping dual-write, reverting flag, aborting jobs`. Keep it short.

aj: I'll draft the abort post and the checklist for after-action.

kevin: I added a quick checklist to the runbook for steps to verify data parity if we need to compare: `select id, jsonb_strip_nulls(payload) from orders where id in (...)` and a small Python parity script.

sarah: All preflight tasks noted. I won't be available during the first 10 minutes of the window (calendar conflict) but reachable by DM.

maria: Thanks team. If nobody objects, we'll treat this as confirmed. Post any late blockers here. :thumbsup:

oliver: :thumbsup: leaving smoke scripts and health-check results in the thread during deploy.

aj: Confirmed, will run dry-run tonight and report.

maria: Closing prep — will re-open thread 30m before window starts for final go/no-go.
